alt: Two panel nope and yes meme: an orange cat turns away from "doing homework" and happily points at "snack break number 4".
Distracted meme with original art: a pencil labeled "me" walks with a notebook labeled "my homework" but turns to stare at a phone labeled "one new notification".
Everything is fine meme: a calm grey cat sips cocoa at a desk while the homework papers around it are on fire, with a speech bubble saying "this is fine" under the caption "five tests this week".
Expanding brain meme in four panels: a brain grows from "reading my notes" to "highlighting everything" to "making flashcards" to a beaming brain for "teaching it to my cat".
A backpack with legs zooms out of the classroom door in a cloud of dust as the wall bell rings, captioned "when the bell rings on a Friday".
Two buttons meme: a nervous blue blob sweats over choosing between a red button "start early" and a blue button "start at 11 PM".
A puzzled brown bear labeled "me" points at a floating video screen labeled "a three hour video" with the caption "is this a study break?".
Change my mind meme: a smug green frog sits at an outdoor table with a mug and a sign reading "homework should be optional on birthdays, change my mind".
Surprised reaction meme: "me: studies zero minutes", "the quiz: is hard", "me:" above a shocked hamster with wide eyes and an open mouth.
Success meme: a determined green turtle pumps its fist on the grass, captioned "found my missing homework in the other pocket".
Nobody versus me meme: "nobody:" then "me at 11:59 PM:" above a cat typing at a laptop at top speed, captioned "submitted with one minute left".
How it started versus how it is going: a tall shiny new pencil smiling in September next to a tiny worn out stub of a pencil with a bandage in May.
Four panel plan meme: a penguin presents a flip chart with steps "make a planner", "write it all down", "never open it again", then stares in shock at "never open it again".
Trade offer meme: a confident phone character in a bow tie offers "I receive: your whole afternoon" and "you receive: one funny video".
Waiting meme: a dusty dog sits on a bench covered in cobwebs next to a printer showing an error, captioned "me waiting for the printer to work".
